public_definitions: The goal is to review the Factory F production dashboard for the 2018-2023 operations record, then choose the follow-up route for the output trend.
The comparison scope is the output trend from 2018 to 2023 as depicted in the chart.
The supplied rules are to use the dashboard view as the evidence source for the routing decision and to select one of the three predefined options.
